summary_md: **Kaneki ([@rk0neki](https://x.com/rk0neki/status/2115632253996814516))** presents **OpenKatana**, an open-source video editor that an AI agent drives from ComfyUI (built on Comfy's SDK): drop in assets, write a brief, and Claude cuts the edit. The repo also lists a Studio UI, CLI and MCP interface.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - rk0neki/OpenKatana: Agent-driven video editing with Studio, ComfyUI Apps, CLI and MCP. Turn photos, footage and music into finished edits.

relevance: Agent-driven editing integrated with ComfyUI generation, with MCP access for other harnesses.

media.description: Demo edit video; preview frame shows two men on a crowded beach in a tug-of-war scene (credited CC BY anime 'Koji').
